description_zh: Cruise AV减速准备向右变道时，一辆车道分割车辆从右侧突然切入，碰撞其右后角。

source_snippets: A Cruise autonomous vehicle… was traveling southeast bound… slowed down to change into the right adjacent lane due to traffic cones ahead. The driver… disengaged from autonomous mode and, shortly thereafter, a lane-splitting car made contact with the right rear corner of the Cruise AV, damaging the Cruise AV’s right lower tail lamp.
evidence.reason: 报告描述Cruise AV减速并准备向右变道，随后一辆车道分割车辆从右侧撞击其右后角，可建模为ego向右变道，NPC从右侧相邻车道突然切入。鉴于“shortly thereafter”暗示突然性，trig_ttc取1.5；天气晴朗、下午，控制信号未知。
